coordinate_system: normalized image coordinates; top-left origin; suggested rectangles require responsive validation

marker_rules.town: Put optical centre just above the corresponding house roof, anchored to the same slot button. Do not duplicate the marker inside the image.
marker_rules.surfaces: Top-right of the corresponding object hotspot; avoid hiding the screen, book cover, or character face.
marker_rules.settings: marker-pending.png may also be reused as a STATIC settings cog in app chrome, with a settings label; reserve rotation for actual pending generation.
marker_rules.help: marker-help.png for tutorial/help affordances, never a job error or content eligibility gate
marker_rules.failure: marker-retry.png with real explanatory text and a working retry action

objects.image_fit: Trim using visible_bounds_alpha_gt_8 from the master manifest, preserve alpha, contain within target rectangle; never stretch.

neighbour_shelf.note: One selected object at a time, bottom aligned to shelf surface.

neighbour_table.note: One selected object, bottom aligned. Keep original book on left visible.

objects.text_note: Render vocabulary as app text. Text-safe coordinates refer to complete original source PNG canvas, before optical trimming. Transform consistently with the picture.

care.watering_can: Momentary visual prop or labelled care action near the sill; do not cover the fixed phone, console, or camera.
care.droplets: Transient small overlay travelling toward plants during a real care action, never a persistent wet background.
care.sparkles: Transient success feedback only; do not indicate saved progress until save succeeds.
care.recovery: Replace only plant condition; preserve maturity. Keep all trio states registered as supplied.
